tools.name: airbrake_list_projects
tools.description: List the Airbrake projects your user can see, with id, name, last deploy, notice total, rejected count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Start here to get a project_id. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project
tools.description: Get one Airbrake project: name, last deploy id/time, notice total, rejection count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_groups
tools.description: List a project's error groups ("errors" in the Airbrake app): each with id, resolved flag, error type/message/backtrace, context (environment, severity, component/action), last notice time, notice counts and last deploy. Sorted by last notice by default; order by notice_count, weight or created inst

tools.name: airbrake_get_group
tools.description: Get one error group in full: resolved flag, every error with its complete backtrace (file, function, line, column), context, last deploy, last notice id/time, notice counts and creation time. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_get_group_stats
tools.description: Occurrence counts over time for one error group: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted) and `limited` (dropped by rate limits), aggregated per period, from `since` until `until` (default now). Use it to see whether an error is spiking or fading. Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{proj

tools.name: airbrake_list_notices
tools.description: List the individual occurrences (notices) of one error group, newest first: each with id, deploy, errors and backtrace, context (environment, hostname, app version, user, URL, severity, notifier), environment, session and request params, and created time. Optionally only notices of one app version.

tools.name: airbrake_get_notice_status
tools.description: Check what happened to a reported error, by the notice id that Airbrake's create-notice API returned: code = processed (groupId = its error group), rejected (message = why, e.g. an app-version filter), archived (past retention) or not_found (unknown or still processing). Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/pr

tools.name: airbrake_list_deploys
tools.description: List a project's tracked deploys: environment, username/email of the deployer, repository, revision (commit) and version. Use it to correlate new errors with a release. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys.

tools.name: airbrake_get_deploy
tools.description: Get one deploy: environment, deployer, repository, revision and version. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys/{deploy_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_activities
tools.description: List a project's activity feed: who did what and when (for example group.resolved), with user name, activity, the affected object (trackableType/trackableId) and timestamps. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/activities.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project_stats
tools.description: Error volume over time for a whole project: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted), `limited` (dropped by rate limits) and `overQuota` (dropped over the plan quota), aggregated per period (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h). Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{project_id}/stats.

tools.name: airbrake_mute_group
tools.description: WRITE: mute one error group. Airbrake removes it from the default error list and stops ALL notifications for it (email, Slack and other integrations) until it is unmuted. Notices are still recorded. Reversible with airbrake_unmute_group. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_

tools.name: airbrake_unmute_group
tools.description: WRITE: unmute one error group, so it is back in the default error list and its notifications resume. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/unmuted.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: airbrake_list_groups, airbrake_list_notices, airbrake_get_notice_status, airbrake_list_deploys, airbrake_list_activities, airbrake_mute_group, airbrake_unmute_group · Private data: airbrake_get_group · Public sink: airbrake_list_deploys, airbrake_mute_group.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: airbrake_list_groups, airbrake_list_notices, airbrake_get_notice_status, airbrake_list_deploys, airbrake_list_activities, airbrake_mute_group, airbrake_unmute_group · Private data: airbrake_get_group · Public sink: airbrake_list_deploys, airbrake_mute_group

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
